values.quote: Pro, Enterprise, Education, IoT Enterprise / IoT Enterprise LTSC | Windows 10, version 1607 [10.0.14393] and later | 0 (Default) | Allow Windows Update drivers.
values.evidence: Windows 11 Pro 25H2 (build 26200) keeps REG_DWORD 0 here next to the policy's Behavior, highrange, lowrange, mergealgorithm and policytype values; read-only check on the test PC, 2026-10-23.
values.reason: This key is Windows' own default policy store, not a local override. Windows default writes 0 back instead of deleting it, so the PC matches stock Windows. It is offered only on the builds and editions Microsoft documents for this policy.
